capabilities: Calculate spreadsheet-like tables in ```calc blocks with Excel-style formulas and cross-table references
Insert lab tables through Alt+S forms (solution prep, RAFT recipes, sample lists, sampling timetables)
Build a chemical database from chemical notes for MW/PROP lookups and autocomplete suggestions
Draw flow rig diagrams from parts tables and save dated SVG snapshots
Install and update bundled templates, scripts and a CSS snippet, with an optional planning kit
extras: Marked as beta: the planning kit and multi-kit system are described as not yet tested by many people. Needs Obsidian 1.14 or newer. No network use, no accounts, no paid features; data-folder access is desktop only. Some features (rig snapshots, meeting deck) are desktop only. Manifest carries an unreviewed-by-staff notice.
motivation: It started as the author's PhD lab notebook; the vocabulary is a chemistry lab's.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to run live calculations inside notes or to support lab-notebook needs like hazard tables, reagent lookups and standard sample tables for chemistry experiments.

relations.evidence: Templater is still used by some note templates (project, concept, topic hub) until they move into Lab Kit
Meta Bind's button templates (adds the missing ones; a second Fix puts the kit's action back on a kit button
Dataview belongs to the planning kit

summary: Chemistry lab notebook plugin with spreadsheet-style calc tables, snippet forms for lab tables, a chemical database, hazard headers and flow rig diagrams.
